clearance_review: The source leaf width after global scale is 0.89716185 m versus a narrow jamb passage of 0.88355331 m; even 1% shrink leaves 4.64 mm excess width, so rigid recentering alone cannot fit it. Uniform 2% Panel/Handle reduction gives width 0.87921762 m. Shift the moving assembly 0.99 mm toward the hinge: side gaps are about 0.68 mm at the hinge and 3.66 mm at the latch, giving room for the thick leaf corner to sweep. Scale about the original hinge-facing leaf plane to preserve its depth alignment with the source knuckles. This is a reviewed graphics-asset fitting approximation, not manufacturer dimensions; runtime collision tolerances are unchanged.
unlatched_review: No distinct latch or lock bolt is present in the inspected geometry. Both lever handles, the leaf, hinge pieces and frame retain their collisions in the common closed-unlatched state.
modifications: Use the existing geometry-identical local GLB with original source images removed and independently authored flat materials; retain original GLB/USDZ untouched.
